name: CoinPay Wallet
summary: Non-custodial multi-chain wallet with one-click x402 payments and bulk payouts.
description:
CoinPay Wallet is a non-custodial, cross-browser (MV3) wallet for the CoinPay multi-chain platform.

- Create or import a BIP-39 wallet. The seed is encrypted at rest (WebCrypto AES-256-GCM + PBKDF2) and never leaves your device; signing happens inside the extension's background worker, so private keys are never exposed to a web page.
- Derives addresses for BTC, BCH, ETH, POL and SOL (with USDC on ETH/POL/SOL), matching the CoinPay web wallet.
- Backup-confirmation gate before the wallet is usable, plus a configurable idle auto-lock.
- One-click x402 (HTTP 402) payment approval for sites that request payment.
- Bulk payouts: a site can request many payments at once via window.coinpay.payBatch and you approve the whole run once, with per-payment progress. Before approving you see what the paying address holds against what the run needs, so a short balance is visible up front instead of surfacing as failed transactions.
- Sites connect per-origin and only after you approve the prompt.

Source: https://github.com/profullstack/coinpayportal/tree/master/packages/extension
